title: gh-shapeup config
description: Tells the gh-shapeup CLI and Action where the GitHub Project is and what its fields, options, labels and templates are called. It holds names only: issues, statuses, cycles and hill positions are always read live from GitHub, and field and option ids are looked up by these names on every run.

projectOwner.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the GitHub Project (the betting table).

projectOwnerType.description: Whether projectOwner is a user or an organization.

projectNumber.description: Number of the GitHub Project, as in /users/<owner>/projects/<number>.

statusField.description: Name of the project's single-select field that holds the Shape Up status.

appetiteField.description: Name of the project's single-select field that holds a pitch's appetite.

cycleField.description: Name of the project's iteration field whose iterations are the cycles.

hillField.description: Name of the project's Number field that holds a scope's hill position (0-100). An empty value counts as 0.

statuses.description: Option names of the status field for each Shape Up state.

shaped.description: Shaped and waiting for the betting table.

bet.description: Bet on a cycle, not started.

dropped.description: Dropped or stopped by the circuit breaker.

appetites.description: Maps each value of the CLI's --appetite to an option name of the appetite field.

pitchLabel.description: Label that marks a pitch issue.

scopeLabel.description: Label that marks a scope issue.

cooldownLabel.description: Label that marks a cooldown issue.

bugLabel.description: Label that marks a bug issue.

assignee.description: Login the CLI assigns to every issue it creates, or null for none.

templateDir.description: Folder of the issue templates the CLI reads, relative to the repository root.

generatedBranch.description: Orphan branch where the Action commits hill chart SVGs. It must start with generated/ and must not be used for anything else.

chartAlt.description: Alt text of the hill chart image written into pitch bodies.

kinds.description: For each issue kind, its template file and how CLI parameters map to the template's ## section headings. Kinds left out keep their defaults.

reports.description: For pitch done and scope done, the completion report's template file and its ## section headings, in order. The defaults are Outcome, Scopes, Accepted limits and Follow-ups for a pitch, and Outcome, Evidence and Follow-ups for a scope, with the templates at .github/shapeup/pitch-report.md and .github/shapeup/scope-report.md. Reports left out keep their defaults.

template.description: File name of the issue template inside templateDir.

sections.description: Maps a CLI parameter (lower-case, hyphenated) to the ## heading it fills. The CLI's own parameters title, from, footnote, reason, reason-file, report, report-file, appetite, pitch, cycle, position and force cannot name a section.

required.description: Parameters that must be given when an issue of this kind is created.

template.description: Path of the report template, relative to the repository root, such as .github/shapeup/scope-report.md. If the file exists, its ## sections are the report's and must include every heading in sections.

sections.description: The ## headings a report must have, in order, each with content.
